title: nf-core/phyloplace pipeline - params.phylosearch_input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.phylosearch_input

target.errorMessage: Target name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

hmm.errorMessage: HMM profile file: extension .hmm, optionally gzipped (.gz); no other compression format is supported.

extract_hmm.errorMessage: Name of the profile to extract from a multi-profile HMM file.

min_bitscore.errorMessage: Minimum bitscore for hits to this HMM.

refseqfile.errorMessage: Multiple sequence alignment of the reference sequences: extension .aln, .alnfa, .alnfaa, .alnfna, .mfa, .fa, .fna, .faa, .fasta, .ph, .phy or .phylip, optionally gzipped (.gz); no other compression format is supported.

refphylogeny.errorMessage: Newick file with the reference phylogeny: extension .newick, .nwk or .tree, optionally gzipped (.gz); no other compression format is supported.

model.errorMessage: Phylogenetic model to use in placement, see EPA-NG documentation.

alignmethod.errorMessage: Method to use for aligning: 'hmmer', 'clustalo' or 'mafft'.

taxonomy.errorMessage: Optional tab-separated taxonomy file: extension .tsv or .tax, optionally gzipped (.gz); no other compression format is supported.

reftreename.errorMessage: Optional name of the reference tree this row places onto. Rows sharing a name are summarised jointly, in addition to individually, and must share the same reference phylogeny.
